Notice Date: August 15, 2026
Requested Service: Partial knee replacement, CPT 27446
Treating Surgeon: Duval, MD, Orthopedic Surgery

Dear Appeals Review Team,

I am writing to appeal the denial of prior authorization for CPT 27446 (partial knee replacement), as stated in the Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination dated August 15, 2026. The stated reason for denial was that "the requested procedure does not meet the plan's criteria for medical necessity." This appeal is submitted within the 180-day appeal window stated in the notice (deadline February 11, 2027).

I understand that Louisiana Healthcare Connections applies the Evolent Clinical Guideline 1763 for Knee Arthroplasty (Guideline Number Evolent_CG_1763) to determine medical necessity for this procedure. Below I address the General Requirements and the Unicompartmental Knee Arthroplasty (UKA)/Partial Knee Replacement (PKA) criteria in that guideline and show how my clinical record satisfies each one.

**General Requirements for elective knee arthroplasty**

The guideline states that elective knee arthroplasty may be considered if, among other things:

"Knee pain with documented loss of function, which may include painful weight bearing, painful or inadequate range of motion to accomplish age appropriate activities of daily living (ADLs) and/or employment, and painful mechanical catching, locking, or popping."

My record documents 14 months of progressive knee pain that is unrelieved by rest, an inability to climb stairs without assistance, and nighttime pain that wakes me 3-4 times per night. This satisfies the pain and loss-of-function requirement.

The guideline further requires:

"Individual is medically stable and optimized for surgery, and any treatable comorbidities are adequately medically managed such as diabetes, nicotine addiction, or an excessively high BMI."
"Individual does not have an active local or systemic infection."
"Individual does not have active, untreated drug dependency (including but not limited to narcotics, opioids, muscle relaxants) unless engaged in treatment program."

My record confirms no active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and non-smoker status, satisfying these requirements.

The guideline also requires "Non-operative management must include at least TWO or more of the following": I completed supervised physical therapy focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion (24 visits, April 28, 2026 to June 23, 2026, per the physical therapy discharge note), NSAIDs for 6 months with inadequate relief, and a corticosteroid injection on April 12, 2026 that provided only 2 weeks of partial relief. This satisfies at least two of the listed non-operative treatment modalities (physical therapy, pharmacologic treatment, and injection).

**Unicompartmental Knee Arthroplasty (UKA)/Partial Knee Replacement (PKA) criteria**

The guideline states that "Medial or lateral UKA/PKA may be medically necessary when ALL of the following criteria are met":

"At least 12 weeks of pain localized to the medial or lateral compartment" — My symptom duration of 14 months of progressive pain, with imaging confirming isolated medial compartment disease, exceeds this threshold.

"Unless bone-on-bone articulation is present, failure of at least 12 weeks of non-operative treatment, including at least TWO of the following..." — My MRI dated June 29, 2026 documents full-thickness cartilage loss with bone-on-bone apposition in the medial compartment, which the guideline treats as satisfying this element independent of the treatment-failure requirement. In addition, and as noted above, I completed 8 weeks of supervised physical therapy, 6 months of NSAIDs, and a corticosteroid injection without durable relief.

"Total arc of motion (goniometer) > 90 degrees" — My exam noted range of motion limited by pain; the specific goniometer measurement is [total arc of motion in degrees, from Dr. Duval's exam note] and is being submitted with this appeal.

"Normal ACL or stable reconstructed ACL per physical exam test" — My exam included positive provocative testing on the affected side; the specific ACL stability finding (e.g., Lachman/anterior drawer result) is [ACL stability exam finding from Dr. Duval's exam note] and is enclosed.

"Contracture ≤ 10 degrees upon physical exam (goniometer)" — The specific contracture measurement is [flexion contracture measurement in degrees, from exam note] and is enclosed.

"Angular deformity ≤ 10 degrees, passively correctable to neutral upon physical exam (goniometer)" — The specific angular deformity measurement is [angular deformity measurement in degrees, from exam note] and is enclosed.

"Weight-bearing radiographs demonstrate only unicompartmental disease (with or without patellofemoral involvement), described as Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 or grade 4 degeneration" — My available imaging is an MRI dated June 29, 2026 showing Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4 changes with full-thickness cartilage loss and bone-on-bone apposition limited to the medial compartment. I understand the guideline notes that "MRI should not be the primary radiographic test used to determine the presence or severity of arthritic changes in the joint," and if weight-bearing radiographs are required to complete the file, [weight-bearing knee radiograph report confirming Kellgren-Lawrence grade and unicompartmental distribution] will be obtained and submitted promptly, or is enclosed if already performed.

"No corticosteroid injection into the joint within 12 weeks of surgery" — My corticosteroid injection was administered on April 12, 2026. My surgery is scheduled for [scheduled surgery date], which is more than 12 weeks after the injection, satisfying this requirement.

"No prior arthroscopic knee surgery within 6 months of surgery" — [Confirmation of no arthroscopic knee surgery within the 6 months preceding the scheduled surgery date] is enclosed/available upon request; my record does not document any such procedure.

**Contraindications**

The guideline lists "Contraindications for Medial or Lateral UKA/PKA," including active infection, inflammatory arthritis, ACL instability, significant arthritic involvement of the opposite compartment, and others. None of these contraindications are present in my case: I have no active infection, my MRI shows disease isolated to the medial compartment, and I have no documented inflammatory arthritis or meniscectomy history in the record provided.

**Conclusion**

Based on the above, my clinical record satisfies the General Requirements and the medial/lateral UKA/PKA-specific criteria of Evolent Clinical Guideline 1763, and none of the listed contraindications apply. I respectfully request that Louisiana Healthcare Connections reverse the denial of CPT 27446 and authorize the partial knee replacement recommended by my surgeon, Dr. Duval.

Enclosed with this appeal are copies of:
- Physical therapy discharge note (visits April 28, 2026 – June 23, 2026)
- Medication and injection records (NSAID trial; corticosteroid injection April 12, 2026)
- MRI report dated June 29, 2026
- Orthopedic exam notes from Dr. Duval
- [Any additional weight-bearing radiograph report, goniometer measurements, and ACL exam findings referenced above, if available]

Please contact me at [phone number] or [email address] if additional information is needed. I request written confirmation of receipt of this appeal and a decision within the timeframe required for ACA/Marketplace internal appeals.

Sincerely,
